description: This source file contains map generation logic for the Battle for Wesnoth game, including height map creation, terrain assignment, lakes, rivers, villages, castles, roads, and map output formatting.

classes.name: road_path_calculator
classes.description: Calculates the cost of building roads over terrain, considering windiness and terrain types.

classes.name: is_valid_terrain
classes.description: Checks if a terrain tile is within a list of valid terrain types.

classes.name: terrain_height_mapper
classes.description: Maps terrain types based on height thresholds defined in configuration.

classes.name: terrain_converter
classes.description: Converts terrain types based on height, temperature, and configuration rules.

methods.name: generate_height_map
methods.description: Generates a height map with hills, valleys, and normalization.

methods.name: generate_lake
methods.description: Recursively creates lakes at specified locations.

methods.name: generate_river
methods.description: Creates rivers flowing downhill from a source point.

methods.name: random_point_at_side
methods.description: Returns a random point on the border of the map.

methods.name: output_map
methods.description: Outputs the terrain map as a string, focusing on the central area.

methods.name: default_generate_map
methods.description: Main function to generate a complete map with terrain, lakes, rivers, villages, castles, roads, and labels.
